bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to local government; repealing deadlines for establishment of special service districts and housing improvement districts; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 428A.101; 428A.21.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REPEALER. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 428A.101; and 428A.21,+]

[+ are repealed. +]

APPENDIX
Repealed Minnesota Statutes: 26-06970

428A.101 DEADLINE FOR SPECIAL SERVICE DISTRICT UNDER GENERAL LAW.
The establishment of a new special service district after June 30, 2028, requires enactment of a special law authorizing the establishment.
428A.21 DEADLINE FOR HOUSING IMPROVEMENT DISTRICTS UNDER GENERAL LAW.
The establishment of a new housing improvement area after June 30, 2028, requires enactment of a special law authorizing the establishment of the area.
